summary: Daniel Michelotti, 20, a Breckenridge Ski Resort employee from Spring Grove, IL, was killed in an avalanche in a backcountry area off Highway 6 west of Arapahoe Basin near Loveland Pass; leading a trio of three, he triggered the slide and was carried about 1,000 feet and nearly completely buried. His friends extricated him with their snowboards; none of the three carried a beacon, shovel, or probe.
location: backcountry off Highway 6 west of Arapahoe Basin, near Loveland Pass
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group / Arapahoe Basin Ski Patrol / Keystone Ski Patrol / Summit County Ambulance
notes: Thornton Weather (opened by the mining subagent run 601). Date: story says Michelotti was killed 'on Wednesday'; 2010-03-03 was a Wednesday and the story published ~March 4, 2010. Distinct from id 3024 (2010-01-06 Battle Mountain Vail avalanche).
